name: eslint
description_en: Find and fix problems in your JavaScript code.
readme_excerpt: ESLint Website | Configure ESLint | Rules | Contribute to ESLint | Report Bugs | Code of Conduct | X | Discord | Mastodon | Bluesky ESLint is a tool for identifying and reporting on patterns found in ECMAScript/JavaScript code. In many ways, it is similar to JSLint and JSHint with a few exceptions: - ESLint uses Espree for JavaScript parsing. - ESLint uses an AST to evaluate patterns in code. - ESLint is completely pluggable, every single rule is a plugin and you can add more at runtime.
